title: PackDisabler for Hypixel Skyblock
description: a fabric mod to remove the official custom skyblock texturepack from hypixel skyblock
body: # PackDisabler Hypixel Skyblock forces a custom resource pack to every connecting player. PackDisabler intercepts it at the network level, silently tells the server it loaded, and keeps your client on vanilla visuals. ## Why use PackDisabler? - The Skyblock pack slows down loading time (more DT YEY!) - The Official Hypixel Skyblock pack is dogshit like omg - You get to keep using your current texturepack with no issues ## Credits Item data sourced from [NotEnoughUpdates-REPO](https://github.com/NotEnoughUpdates/NotEnoughUpdates-REPO)
